title: andira inermis subsp. grandiflora
intro: Andira inermis subsp. grandiflora, commonly known as the Andira tree, is a plant species native to South America, characterized by its large, fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of the Andira tree include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antiparasitic, and antiviral properties, further supporting the plant's medicinal value.
